notes.subject: אותה
notes.rationale: Pointed אִוְּתָה 'desired' (so KJV, BSB) vs read as pronoun אֹתָהּ 'it' referring to the fig (so JPS 'nor first-ripe fig which my soul desireth').

notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש here is appetite/craving, rendered 'bel' (seat of desire), not a separate 'soul'.

notes.subject: בכורה
notes.rationale: The early-ripe fig; rare word appearing only here in this sense.

translation: Oi sori bilong mi, bilong mi i no gutpela, bilong mi i kamap olsem ol kaikai bilong samer ol i fanim pinis, olsem ol hap grap ol i livim bihain long wok kisim grap; i no gat wanpela hap grap bilong kaikai, i no gat fig i ripe maus pas we bel bilong mi i wantim ⟨em⟩.

tokens.gloss: olsem ol kaikai ol i fanim
olsem ol hap ol i livim
